Ultimately, whether or not a mandatory general surgery rotation is necessary depends on various factors, including the specific needs of the institution, local healthcare policies, and the goals of undergraduate surgical education. It's crucial to weigh these factors carefully and engage with faculty, students, and external stakeholders to determine the most effective approach for providing high-quality surgical education.
